source.citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D.

coverage.timezone: unprovided naive local transaction time; calendar dates preserved, no invented UTC conversion
coverage.completeness_basis: UCI publisher says all transactions over 2009-12-01 through 2011-12-09; source-declared retrospective complete ledger for interior covered calendar days, not audited real-time availability
coverage.zero_rule: Missing SKU-date is zero recorded positive sales only within publisher-declared complete ledger. Whole-ledger zero dates are disclosed separately. Unknown dates supplied to engine remain null and block applicable forecasts.
coverage.first_day_basis: Publisher names 2009-12-01 as coverage start; first transaction time alone does not imply an incomplete day.
coverage.last_day_basis: Conservatively exclude maximum transaction calendar day because end-of-day completeness is unproven.

row_handling.positive_target: unique exact source rows, numeric product StockCode with optional <=2-letter suffix, digit Invoice, quantity>0, Price>0; retain missing customer/description if other fields valid
row_handling.exact_duplicates: SHA256 over complete original row values, keep first globally across both sheets; no customer-level modeling or output
row_handling.returns: negative quantity or C invoice separate absolute-unit ledger; not positive target, net-sales sensitivity only
row_handling.non_product: exclude nonstandard product codes (postage, discounts, adjustments etc); no latent product mapping
row_handling.outliers: all qualifying positive quantities retained, no test-derived clipping
row_handling.historical_discontinuation: no post-training sales based removal; eligible catalog can include discontinued items; report zero-volume test slice

label_availability.availability_basis: transaction timestamps used as retrospective proxy; historical system-known/public-known replay not established
label_availability.right_censoring: last calendar day excluded; sales can be demand-censored by unknown stockouts

split.selection_basis: training only; zero-sales or historically inactive test series remain eligible; no test-based item selection
split.population: known SKU, all countries aggregated within original single UK retailer

quality_counter_note: Raw missing/price/quantity/non-product/exact-duplicate counters overlap; exclusive_row_partition alone sums to raw rows. Returns and other rejected rows are classified before duplicate-positive exclusion.

sheet_overlap.handling: Globally exact-row dedup across both sheets; keep first source order, no duplicate split leakage. Invoice groups never span calendar dates in this workbook.
sheet_overlap.cross_sheet_duplicate_exact_count: not separately measured from within-sheet duplicates; total exact duplicate count is verified
